_what: The alignment-census item list. One entry per collection, with its state. This is the finite work list the census dispatches from, and it is also what render-catalog.mjs joins the harvest records against. A record with no entry here is not in the census.

_states.needs-address: Label known, mainnet address not. Re-resolve, then harvest.
_states.needs-harvest: Address known. No schema-valid v2 record exists yet.
_states.verified: Harvested AND reproduced exactly by an independent re-harvest (verify-record.mjs).
_states.unresolved-slug: Slug does not resolve to a mainnet contract. A legitimate result, not a failure.
_states.out-of-scope-chain: Not on Ethereum mainnet. Out of scope for a mainnet-fork seed.

_scope.ruling: rth, 2026-08-21: the Milady/Remilia tranche IS the catalog. BAYC->APE, Azuki->ANIME, Doodles->DOOD, Pepe->PEPE and mfers->MFER are dropped — those families have no real alignment need and the point is already made. Recorded so a later seat does not re-open it as an oversight.
_scope.outOfScopeChainNote: 9 of the 83 listed collections are on Avalanche, Polygon or chain 900. Not individually enumerated by the source seat; enumerate on the next pass over miladyderivatives.com/api/data.json.

milady.firstPartyNote: A first-party collection is the TARGET side of alignment, never the aligned side. Shown for scale, never counted as owing. Adjudicated by rth 2026-08-21; see tools/provenance.json for the contested rulings.

alignmentTarget.name: Milady Cult Coin
alignmentTarget.note: Both registry legs measured on a mainnet fork 2026-08-21. LADYS is OUT (rth): a Solana-launched extractive grift coin, out of jurisprudence — the objection is to what it is, not to how deep it trades. Do not re-propose it.
alignmentTarget.residual: The scan covered the four standard fee tiers only. A non-standard tier, a hooked V4 pool, or a ZAMM pool under an unprobed fee selector is still invisible.
